core_obligations: Reduce the statement about composing ring maps to the statement about modules, which is more general (proof lines 8898-8900).

For exactness, tensor an exact complex first along the flat ring map and then along the flat module, rewrite the resulting complex using the canonical isomorphism, and read off flatness; trace the argument backwards for faithful flatness (proof lines 8901-8921).
proof_roadmap: Reduce ring maps to the module statement (proof lines 8897-8900).
Chain the two exactness properties and rewrite by the canonical isomorphism (proof lines 8901-8922).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a composition of flat, respectively faithfully flat, ring maps is flat, respectively faithfully flat, and that a flat module over a flat extension is flat over the base (statement lines 8888-8895). The proof does not use any criterion in terms of ideals: it reduces the ring statement to the module statement, takes an exact complex, applies flatness of the ring map and then flatness of the module, and identifies the resulting complex with the one obtained directly by tensoring over the base using the canonical isomorphism of twice-extended tensor products (proof lines 8897-8922). Deciding to prove the more general module statement is what makes the argument short. H2.
